limits.index: GitHub code search, literal (quoted) queries scoped to the pinned upstream repo: absence claims are scoped to the indexed surface — unindexed repos cannot answer; incomplete results are retried once after 20s, a persistent incomplete stays unknown (no-verdict)
limits.verification: every idl candidate (max 5/program) fetched; ok = the file really contains the literal; binding from the file itself
limits.premise: local git grep against the foreign clone at HEAD, parser sources only
limits.dialectPin: the pin is the upstream repo the foreign parser cites; it names a SOURCE, not a decoded interface — no bytes are adopted by this tool
limits.licensing: SPDX read from the API per repo; null = unlicensed, GPL-* = copyleft; neither may be committed
